reference_descriptions: The tissue is brain. The image shows a dense cellular architecture with numerous small, round to oval nuclei dispersed throughout a fibrillary background. There is a notable presence of red blood cells within vascular spaces. The stroma appears to be finely fibrillar, and there is no evident necrosis or significant mitotic activity in this patch.

Brain tissue with a diffuse, finely fibrillar neuropil background containing numerous small to intermediate glial-appearing nuclei and scattered vacuolated cells. Small blood vessels are present, with mild focal perivascular lymphocytic inflammation.
